mainEntity.name: How long does outdoor kitchen construction usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdoor kitchen construction timelines depend on the complexity of the design and scope of work, including site preparation and utility installations. A simpler project might take a few weeks, while a more intricate custom build can extend to several months. Process clarity is achieved through detailed scheduling, where phases like foundation work, utility rough-ins, cabinetry installation, and finishing touches are outlined. Weather conditions can also be a factor that influences the overall project timeline.
